name: opencode-goal-workspace
description: Portable Codex-style goal contract: shared core, CLI, and OpenCode plugin

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nikomohr/goal-core && npm run build -w @nikomohr/goal-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nikomohr/goal-core && npm run typecheck -w @nikomohr/goal-core && npm run typecheck -w @nikomohr/goal-cli && npm run typecheck -w @nikomohr/opencode-goal
